text:
sanjay: deploybot kicked off: Quokka Industries dedicated rollout request received for 2024-07-18 02:00 UTC. pinned model: rdx-v2.4.1-quant

deploybot: automated checklist:
- reserved pool: dedicated-prod-quokka
- model artifact: rdx-v2.4.1-quant (sha256: a1b2c3d4)
- canary slice: 2% traffic for 10m
- rollback policy: immediate on error-rate>3% OR p95 latency increase > 40%
- KMS key: customer-kms-qi (rotation window collision check required)
- release notes: https://internal.redwood/relnotes/rdx-v2.4.1

maya: reading notes. couple questions: is this build the one with the updated kv-cache refactor?

liam: yes, it includes kv-cache sticky fixes. we expect faster warmup for repeated prefixes.

jessica-cs: flagged Quokka: they run sensitive inference for fraud alerts. they requested no more than 5m of degraded throughput. keep me in loop.

sanjay: understood. SLO for Quokka: p99 < 500ms, p95 < 250ms. Canary threshold: abort if p95 > 350ms for 3 consecutive minutes.

deploybot: preflight summary attached. smoke tests passed in staging. canary healthcheck script run: `scripts/canary_healthcheck.sh --tenant quokka --model rdx-v2.4.1-quant`

kevin: KMS team — we have a scheduled rotation at 03:15 UTC same night. can we delay rotation or shift rollout?

oncall-bot: @kevin acknowledged. KMS rotation ticket #KMS-4123. will coordinate.

kevin: we can delay rotation to 06:00 UTC. but need a heads-up if rollout fails and we need emergency key ops.

maya: ops note — kv-cache prefix population will take ~8m on a cold slice. suggest priming cache with customer sample prompts during canary ramp.

liam: we can run a priming job. will schedule two bursts at t+1m and t+4m of canary. job: `tools/prime_kvcache --tenant quokka --rate 50qps --duration 60s`

jessica-cs: customer wants a deployment window that avoids their heavy batch runs (02:30-03:00 UTC). can we keep canary before that?

sanjay: schedule: start canary at 02:00 UTC, ramp to 2% for 10m, monitor, then 30% for 20m if stable, then full shift in 2x increments. final handoff targeted 04:00 UTC.

liam: added metric gates to the rollout config: `error_rate`, `p95_latency`, `tail_tokens`, `model_ooms`. post-roll metrics exported to console dashboards.

deploybot: please confirm approvals: @sanjay (eng lead), @kevin (kms), @jessica-cs (customer success), @liam (runtime). reply `+1` to approve.

kevin: +1 (KMS delay ok)

liam: +1 (will run priming and monitor)

maya: +1 (will watch kv-cache warming)

jessica-cs: +1 from CS. i'll send customer notification: `We will start a short canary at 02:00 UTC, low risk; we'll update you by 04:00 UTC or sooner if any action.`

sanjay: noted, locking pinned version rdx-v2.4.1-quant at sha256 a1b2c3d4.

deploybot: rollout scheduled. reminder: abort conditions are strict. if triggered, run: `tools/rollback --tenant quokka --to-version rdx-v2.4.0` and notify #incidents and customer.

maya: one more ops reminder — if p95 spikes but error rate low, check connection pooling and tokenization regressions before rollback. sometimes latency blips due to cold pools.

liam: we'll annotate latency spikes with pool warmup tags in traces.

jessica-cs: thank you. I'll have the customer's contact (amy@quokka.io) on standby.

sanjay: thanks team. I'll post a short postmortem template in case we hit rollback. otherwise i'll update release notes with final metrics. :thumbsup:
